engineeringRecord.analysis: The existing protected accounting.invoices procedure already returns the complete company-filtered invoice list, payments summed, ordered by issue date. Browser serialization of that exact list preserves the displayed order and avoids adding an unauthenticated endpoint.
changes: Added Export CSV next to New invoice; unavailable until invoice data is loaded. Existing create, issue, void and delete controls are preserved.

Added a pure serializer implementing KB-EXP-01, KB-FIN-01, KB-FIN-04, KB-AR-02, KB-INV-03 and KB-SEC-01: UTF-8 BOM, CRLF, nine exact columns, RFC 4180 escaping, unmodified text, invoice currency decimals, UTC dates and null due dates as empty fields.
Paid comes from the existing sum of all linked payments. Only SENT, PARTIAL and OVERDUE have nonnegative outstanding balances; DRAFT, VOID and PAID have zero.

Added 12 automated tests covering formatting, special characters, zero-decimal currencies, negative amounts, overpayments, all/selected/empty companies, multiple payments, order and anonymous rejection. No existing tests changed.
tests: Official fixture loaded with the provided loader before browser evidence. Four actual browser downloads parsed and compared field-for-field to official QA data and screen order.
All five minimum verification scenarios passed. New invoice dialog remains operable. Anonymous accounting redirects to login; supplied request checker reports REJECTED with no invoice data leaked.
Provided run-checks script: pnpm test passed all 36 tests; pnpm typecheck passed. Initial new-test setup errors were corrected before the final run.
Previously reported financial-delete baseline failure was fixed on the assigned branch before this item; the unchanged cascade suite passes.
risks: Exports use the current authenticated list snapshot, matching the displayed data. No public files or export endpoint are introduced.
